title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-103-24一模

items.zh: 虽然青少年爱和父母顶嘴，但是他们内心是尊重父母的。
items.en: Although it is typical of teenagers to talk back to their parents, they respect them deep down.

items.zh: 所有飞往西班牙的乘客请等候，何时出发另行通知。
items.en: All passengers for Spain, please wait here until further notice.

items.zh: 盲目刷题毫无意义，学习方法的关键是要知其然，知其所以然。
items.en: There is no point doing endless practice questions blindly, for the key to effective learning lies in knowing what to do and why.

items.zh: 读了关于这个教授兼宇航员的报道，我逐渐意识到，只要敢于有梦，勤于圆梦，人生就有无限可能。
items.en: Having read the coverage of the professor and astronaut, it dawned on me that as long as one dares to dream and works hard to realize their dream , life holds infinite possibilities.

proverb.en: All this has injected hope into a beleaguered industry
proverb.zh: 所有的这些为这个四面楚歌的行业注入了一缕希望。
